title: 俗世凡尘 第13章 淬体丹俗世凡尘 第14章 庆典

今日天朗气清，恰逢赶集日，云隐镇上人头攒动。陆多福艰难的从人群中分开一条路，挤到一处售卖野味的摊位面前，喘着粗气道：“老板，陆行雕的兽丹怎么卖？”
黝黑壮硕的摊老板打量着这个还不满十四岁的清瘦少年，热情地介绍道：“成年上品的三百文一颗，成年完美的五百文一颗。小哥，你需要哪种？”
“这么贵。你这成色看着都有点发黄了，是不是多放了两日，药性都有点流失了。”陆多福一边说话，一面将兽丹凑到鼻尖面前细细嗅着，生怕买到假货。
老板心里咯噔一下，遇到行家了，想不到这少年居然深知药性，当即打了哈哈：“小哥说笑了，我当日猎杀完猛兽就急忙赶回来了，不料突起大雾，就耽搁了一日功夫。这兽丹虽失了少许药性，但整体保存的还是很好的。这样吧？上品二百五十文一颗，完美的四百文一颗，你看如何？”
“你这有六颗上品，三颗完美，一口价，三两五钱银子我全要了。如何？”
“这可不行，最低三两六钱。猎杀这雕可不容易。”
“那算了，我到别处问问。”陆多福转身就走，却听到身后老板焦急地道：“小哥且慢，就三两六钱，你拿去吧……”
陆多福会心一笑，其实别处根本没有这陆行雕内丹。他敢这么砍价，当然是知道老板的弱点。这兽丹必须存放得当才能保持药性，看这老板的样子，他明显没有合适的容器来收纳这些兽丹，所以这些兽丹会越放越不值钱。
陆行雕，虽然只是一级猛兽，猛兽中最低阶的存在，实力上相当于人类武者的武修境中期。陆行雕不会飞，但是其肉身比较强悍，脚有人的手臂一般粗，羽毛浓密而坚硬，一般的弓箭都难以穿透。
这种猛兽盛产于云隐山附近的迷雾山谷。据师父说，迷雾山谷常年大雾弥漫，灵气极为浓郁，胜过云隐山数倍，曾经不少宗门想把基地建在那里，可惜实在对那大雾束手无策，只得放弃。这些陆行雕吸收了大量灵气，长得壮也就不足为奇了。事实上，就算是武修境五六重的武者，正常情况下也打不过这些陆行雕，主要是大雾之中伸手不见五指，而陆行雕目力却不受迷雾的影响，所以要猎杀这种猛兽也是不容易的。
那么陆多福为什么要买这些陆行雕内丹呢？答案是为了炼丹。陆行雕的肉又柴又硬，没有食用价值，但是其内丹却是淬体丹的主要炼丹材料。
武者的灵力提升后，肉身必须跟上相应的强度。因为无论是灵力的修炼和使用，或者是武者之间的切磋搏斗，都会对身体产生一定程度的负荷消耗。如果不增强肉身，灵力膨胀是对身体有害的。正如海，如果海不够深不够大，而汇入的河流太多，迟早爆满。
淬体丹是云隐门唯一可以自行炼制的初级丹药，是武者最低级的丹药，对于初级武者有淬炼肉身的作用，一般的云隐门弟子可不太容易弄到。陆多福因为有温老头留下的丹方，而且也跟他学着炼过几次，所以他决心自行收集材料，炼制一批出来。
但因为主材料陆行雕内丹的比较难收集，一般的猎户根本不会去迷雾山谷打这种猛兽。陆多福搜寻了好几日，才找到了这味药材。虽然杀了一手好价，但是他还是心疼，攒了几年的私房钱花了七七八八。
跌打草、紫蓝花、青扶藤……一圈药铺逛完，彻底把陆多福的口袋掏空，不过也总算将炼丹材料收集齐全。
回到云药堂，陆多福就准备开始炼丹。从进炉到成丹，要七日之久，中间不能停火，否则前功尽弃。陆多福跟南宫修他们打了招呼，就全身心投入到炼丹中。
陆多福连夜启动了炼丹炉，又置好了炼药鼎。炉子和鼎都是温老头留下的东西，陆多福倒也用的顺手。对于炼丹他也算熟门熟路了，虽然他也只会炼这种最低阶的淬体丹。
虽然之前炼过几次，但那时有温师叔祖在，陆多福在其指点和帮助下，觉得炼丹不过如此。如今一切靠自己，陆多福开始担心起来，生怕炼不成，几年的积蓄就会化为乌有。
怀着三分期待，七分忐忑的心情，陆多福磨药，生火，进炉，提炼，再加料，再提炼，融合，凝丹，开炉，收丹……这整套过程需要先要小火，再转大火，再中火，最后小火，火候要把握好，且不能熄灭。

对于一个十三四岁的少年来说，对着火炉枯坐七天，实在是件无聊透顶的事情。但陆多福却是硬生生憋着一口气，从磨药到收丹，生怕出丁点差错。
寻常人要是七天七夜不合眼，那多半猝死了。幸好陆多福现在已经勉强算个武者了，精力和体力都比常人要好，而且中途打坐归元还可以恢复下体力。饶是如此，熬了七天后到收丹那一刻，陆多福也是眼睛都快睁不开了。
收完丹，陆多福连药性都来不及验，直接就地呼呼大睡起来。一天一夜后，他才起来。此时的陆多福精力虽然恢复了大半，但是灰头土脸，浑身散发着恶臭，他赶紧先洗了个澡，换了身衣服才检验起这批丹药。
陆多福打开了药罐，一股浓郁的药香味扑鼻而来，陆多福细细嗅着，最后满意地点点头。还行，药味比温师叔祖炼的淡了些许，应该是那兽丹药性散失的缘故，但也够了。
一共成丹六十一，八颗药性不足成了废丹，剩余五十三。陆多福倒也没有全部留下，一个人根本用不完这么多，于是交了二十三颗给南宫修。当然，上交的时候陆多福告诉南宫修说这次是首次尝试，炼制不多，全部上交了。
挑了个神清气爽的时候，陆多福开始服用并炼化淬体丹。炼化丹药时炼气就行，不需要功法来辅佐，所以拥有无脉之息的陆多福可以像常人一样炼化。
盘膝静坐，将一粒淬体丹吞入腹中，运转无脉之息。除了口中些许的苦味和腹中微微的辣烫感，陆多福没有别的感觉。陆多福知道这是药力不足，又服下一颗，之后又一颗……
直到第五颗后，丹田内“轰”一下冒起一团热浪，向四肢百脉奔散，接着全身都燥热起来。陆多福大喜，忙运转灵力压制着这团热浪，小心翼翼地引导其在周身运行。热浪所到之处，剧痛无比，经脉如同要爆裂开来一样。
根据温老头留下的药典，这是正常的淬体过程，所以陆多福倒也没有惊慌。浑身大汗的他也顾不得擦拭，只是耐心地运行着灵力。一直持续了一个多时辰，直到那股热浪完全消散，滚烫的身躯随之冷却下来。陆多福身上黏糊糊地感觉好难受，连忙去洗了个澡，发现身上搓下来的污垢比平时多得多，而且腥臭无比。这淬体丹还能把身体里的杂质淬炼出体外……
通体舒畅，如沐春风，连呼吸都觉得比以前顺畅了许多。陆多福眉开眼笑地数着剩下的淬体丹，还剩二十五颗，这可都是宝贝啊……
有了第一次的经验，第二次淬炼就更为顺利了，之后第三次，第四次。每一次都比前一次用掉更多的淬体丹，第四次之后，陆多福流出的汗干净了许多，洗澡也搓不出污垢了。
服用了淬体丹后，配合每日的苦练，陆多福感觉肉身强度明显有提升，无论力量还是体力，都有较大的加强。而他的修为也是水涨船高，进步明显。
两个月内，陆多福一共用淬体丹进行四次淬体，之后就没效果了。陆多福不知道的是，他已经修炼到了武修境三重。之后没有丹药的辅助，他又没有合适的功法来加强肉身，所以他的修炼也随之慢了下来。
武尊境以前，对于武者来说并不难，根据各自资质高低和机遇，达到只是时间长短的问题。要到达武尊境，那就不容易了，不是努力就行的，而武宗以上境界，那是可遇不可求的，是无数武者的毕生追求。强如南宫修，一宗之主，也在武尊境九重上卡了好几年。尽管如此，陆多福两月两个小境界，也算快的了，起码在云隐门这种小门派是如此。
当然，陆多福也不知道自己现在是个什么境界。要知道，对灵力等级的感知，不管对他人还是对自己，都需要武者修习到一定程度，才能凭自己的灵觉才能分辨出来。就好比一个木匠，如果是学徒，你拿根木棍给他，不用量尺的话他肯定说不准这木棍有多长，但如果这是个老师傅，只需徒手比划一下，就能准确说出木棍的长度。
灵觉，一般要进入武尊境后才能产生。不过，灵觉也不是什么时候都管用，如果双方境界差得实在太远，弱的乙方可能察觉不到对方具体的修为境界。还有些人修行了特殊的功法，隐藏气息很厉害，这样别人也很难感知不到他的修为。
不管怎么说，陆多福对于现状还是够满意了，修炼慢一些总比不能修炼的强。

The sky is bright and clear today, it happens to be market day, and Yunyin Town is crowded with people. Lu Duofu separated his way from the crowd with difficulty, squeezed in front of a stall selling game, and gasped: "Boss, how do you sell Lu Xingdiao's beast elixir?"
The dark and muscular stall owner looked at the thin young man who was not yet fourteen years old, and introduced enthusiastically: "Three hundred cents for a top-grade adult, five hundred cents for a perfect adult. Which one do you want, little brother?"
"It's so expensive. Your color looks a little yellow. Maybe it has been stored for two days, and the medicinal properties have been lost." As Lu Duofu spoke, he brought the beast pill to the tip of his nose and smelled it carefully, for fear of buying a fake.
The boss's heart skipped a beat as he met an expert. Unexpectedly, this young man actually knew the properties of the medicine, so he immediately said, "Brother, I was joking. I hurried back after hunting the beast that day. Unexpectedly, there was a heavy fog, which delayed my work for a day. Although this beast elixir has lost a little of its medicinal properties, the overall preservation is still very good. Is that so? Two hundred and fifty cents for the top grade, four hundred cents for the perfect one. What do you think?"
"Here you have six top-grade ones, three of which are perfect. I want them all at one price. I'll take them all for three taels and five cents. How do you like them?"
"That's not possible. The minimum is three to six dollars. Hunting this eagle is not easy."
"Forget it, I'll ask elsewhere." Lu Duofu turned around and left, but heard the boss behind him saying anxiously: "Brother, wait a minute, it's only three to two or six dollars, you can take it..."
Lu Duofu smiled knowingly. In fact, there was no such thing as Lu Xingdiao's inner elixir anywhere else. He dared to bargain like this, of course he knew the boss's weakness. This beast pill must be stored properly to maintain its medicinal properties. Judging from the boss's appearance, he obviously does not have a suitable container to store these beast pills, so these beast pills will become less valuable as they are stored.
Although Lu Xingdiao is only a first-level beast, the lowest level among beasts, his strength is equivalent to that of a human warrior in the middle stage of the martial arts realm. The Land Eagle cannot fly, but its body is relatively strong, its feet are as thick as human arms, and its feathers are thick and hard, making it difficult for ordinary bows and arrows to penetrate.
This beast is abundant in the misty valley near Yunyin Mountain. According to the master, the Misty Valley is filled with heavy fog all year round, and its spiritual energy is extremely rich, several times better than that of Yunyin Mountain. Many sects once wanted to build bases there, but unfortunately they were unable to do anything about the heavy fog and had to give up. These land-walking eagles have absorbed a large amount of spiritual energy, so it is no surprise that they have grown strong. In fact, even warriors at the fifth or sixth level of martial cultivation cannot defeat these Lu Xing Diao under normal circumstances. The main reason is that they can't see their fingers in the heavy fog, but Lu Xing Diao's vision is not affected by the fog, so it is not easy to hunt such ferocious beasts.
So why did Lu Duofu buy these Lu Xingdiao inner elixirs? The answer is to make alchemy. Lu Xingdiao's meat is woody and hard, with no edible value, but its inner elixir is the main alchemy material for the Body Tempering Pill.
After a warrior's spiritual power increases, his physical body must keep up with the corresponding intensity. Because whether it is the cultivation and use of spiritual power, or the fighting between warriors, it will exert a certain degree of load on the body. If the physical body is not strengthened, spiritual expansion will be harmful to the body. Just like the sea, if the sea is not deep enough or big enough, and there are too many rivers flowing into it, it will fill up sooner or later.
Body Tempering Pill is the only junior elixir that Yunyin Sect can refine by itself. It is the lowest elixir for warriors. It has the effect of tempering the physical body of junior warriors. It is not easy for ordinary Yunyin Sect disciples to obtain it. Because Lu Duofu had the elixir recipe left by Old Man Wen and had learned how to refine it several times from him, he decided to collect the materials and refine a batch of them on his own.
But because the main material, Lu Xing Diao Neidan, is relatively difficult to collect, ordinary hunters would never go to the Misty Valley to hunt such beasts. Lu Duofu searched for several days before he found this medicinal material. Although he got a good deal, he still felt distressed. The money he had saved for several years for his private house was spent at 7788.
Bacteria, purpleBlue flowers, green vines... After visiting the medicine shop, Lu Duofu's pockets were completely emptied, but he finally collected all the alchemy materials.
Back at Yunyao Hall, Lu Duofu was ready to start refining elixirs. It takes seven days from entering the furnace to completing the elixir. There cannot be a cessation of fire in the middle, otherwise all the previous efforts will be wasted. Lu Duofu greeted Nangong Xiu and the others and devoted himself to alchemy.
Lu Duofu started the alchemy furnace overnight and set up the alchemy cauldron. The stove and tripod were both left behind by Old Man Wen, and Lu Duofu was quite comfortable with them. He is also familiar with alchemy, although he can only refine the lowest level body tempering elixir.
Although he had practiced alchemy several times before, Master Wen's uncle was there at that time, and with his guidance and help, Lu Duofu felt that alchemy was nothing more than that. Now that everything is on his own, Lu Duofu begins to worry, fearing that if he fails to practice, his savings over the past few years will be wiped out.
With half expectancy and half anxiety, Lu Duofu grinded the medicine, lit a fire, put it into the furnace, refined it, added ingredients, refined it again, fused it, condensed the elixir, opened the furnace, collected the elixir... This whole process required first a small fire, then a high fire, then a medium fire, and finally a small fire. The heat should be controlled well and cannot be extinguished.
For a boy of thirteen or fourteen, sitting in front of the stove for seven days was really boring. But Lu Duofu was holding his breath, from grinding the medicine to collecting the elixir, for fear of making any mistakes.
If an ordinary person does not sleep for seven days and seven nights, he will probably die suddenly. Fortunately, Lu Duofu can barely be considered a warrior now. His energy and physical strength are better than ordinary people, and he can restore his physical strength by meditating and returning to his original state. Even so, when it came time to collect the pills after seven days, Lu Duofu could hardly open his eyes.
After collecting the pills, Lu Duofu didn't even have time to test the properties of the medicine, so he fell asleep on the spot. After a day and a night, he got up. Although Lu Duofu had regained most of his energy at this time, he was still looking gray and his whole body exuded a foul odor. He quickly took a shower and changed his clothes before testing the batch of elixirs.
Lu Duofu opened the medicine jar, and a strong medicinal fragrance came to his nostrils. Lu Duofu sniffed it carefully, and finally nodded with satisfaction. It's okay. The smell of the medicine is a little lighter than the one made by Master Wen's uncle, probably because the medicinal properties of the animal elixir have been lost, but it's enough.
A total of sixty-one elixirs were produced, eight elixirs were insufficient and became useless elixirs, leaving fifty-three. Lu Duofu didn't keep them all. One person couldn't use so many, so he handed over twenty-three to Nangong Xiu. Of course, when handing it in, Lu Duofu told Nangong Xiu that this was his first attempt and there was not much refining, so he handed it all in.
When he felt refreshed, Lu Duofu began to take and refine the Body Tempering Pill. When refining the elixir, just refining the Qi is enough, and does not require the assistance of martial arts, so Lu Duofu, who has the pulseless breath, can refining it like ordinary people.
Sit cross-legged and meditate, swallow a body-tempering pill into your belly, and circulate the pulseless breath. Apart from a slight bitter taste in his mouth and a slight burning sensation in his stomach, Lu Duofu felt nothing else. Lu Duofu knew that the medicine was insufficient, so he took another pill, and then another pill...
After the fifth pill, a wave of heat suddenly appeared in the Dantian, spreading to the limbs and veins, and then the whole body became hot. Lu Duofu was overjoyed and was busy using his spiritual power to suppress the heat wave, carefully guiding it to circulate around his body. Wherever the heat wave reaches, there is excruciating pain, and the meridians feel as if they are about to burst.
According to the pharmacopoeia left by Old Man Wen, this was a normal body tempering process, so Lu Duofu did not panic. He was sweating profusely and didn't even bother to wipe it off, he just patiently used his spiritual power. It lasted for more than an hour, until the heat wave completely dissipated, and the hot body cooled down. Lu Duofu felt sticky and uncomfortable. He quickly went to take a shower and found that there was much more dirt on his body than usual, and the smell was extremely fishy. This body tempering pill can also temper the impurities in the body out of the body...
Feeling relaxed and refreshed, like a spring breeze, even breathing feels much smoother than before. Lu Duofu counted the remaining body tempering pills with a smile on his face. There were twenty-five pills left. These are all treasures...
With the first experience, the second tempering went more smoothly, and then the third and fourth times. Each time he used more body tempering pills than the previous time. After the fourth time, Lu Duofu's sweat became much cleaner, and he could no longer remove any dirt after bathing.
After taking the Body Tempering Pill and working hard every day, Lu Duofu felt that his physical strength had significantly improved, both in terms of strength and physical strength. And his cultivation level has also risen with the tide, and his progress has been obvious.
Within two months, Lu Duofu used the Body Tempering Pill to temper his body four times, but it had no effect after that. What Lu Duofu didn't know was that he had already reached the third level of martial arts cultivation. Afterwards, without the aid of elixirs, and he had no suitable exercises to strengthen his physical body, his cultivation also slowed down.
In the past, it was not difficult for warriors to reach the Martial Master Realm. Depending on their respective qualifications and opportunities, it was only a matter of time to reach it. It is not easy to reach the Martial Master realm. It does not require hard work. However, the realm above the Martial Master is something that can only be encountered but cannot be sought. It is the lifelong pursuit of countless warriors. As strong as Nangong Xiu, the leader of a sect has also been stuck at the ninth level of the Martial Lord Realm for several years. Despite this, Lu Duofu's two small realms in two months are considered fast, at least in a small sect like Yunyin Sect.
Of course, Lu Duofu didn't know what state he was in now. You must know that the perception of the level of spiritual power, whether it is for others or for oneself, requires a warrior to practice to a certain extent before he can distinguish it with his own spiritual sense. It's like a carpenter. If he's an apprentice and you give him a stick, he won't be able to tell the length of the stick without a measuring ruler. But if he's a master craftsman, he can accurately tell the length of the stick just by making gestures with his bare hands.
Spiritual awareness can generally only be generated after entering the Martial Master Realm. However, spiritual awareness does not work all the time. If the realm of the two parties is too far apart, the weak Party B may not be able to detect the specific cultivation realm of the other party. There are also people who practice special skills and are very good at hiding their aura, making it difficult for others to detect their cultivation.
In any case, Lu Duofu is satisfied with the current situation. It is better to practice slower than unable to practice.
